name: Irix
title: Continuity-Bearer of the Ashen Line
quote: I am not lost. I am just very hard to keep.

appearance.build: Slim, lightweight, compact; built for agility, balance, and endurance rather than raw strength
appearance.hair: Dark ash-brown to black, straight; usually worn loose or partially tied to keep clear of horns
appearance.eyes: Deep ember-gold with low-light adaptation; reflect faintly when mana is active or emotions spike
appearance.skin: Warm umber with subtle heat undertones; resilient, rarely marked
appearance.scent: Faint sulphur and charcoal layered with clean heat
appearance.posture: Contained and deliberate; constantly aware of exits, walls, and vertical space; posture relaxes measurably when Jayson is present

siblings.None: Only known surviving bearer of her direct line

appearance.wings: Bat-like Ashen Serathi wings; highly sensitive membrane; complex joint structure; extremely flexible with defined load limits; prone to joint strain under extreme pressure fields
appearance.horns: Curved, swept-back horns; sensitive but resilient; culturally significant and not ornamental by default
appearance.legs: Digitigrade with feline-pawed feet; silent tread, strong balance, clawed pads protected by custom footwear

reactions.wind: Instinctively adjusts stance and wing alignment to avoid silhouette exposure
reactions.water: Cautious; avoids full submersion due to wing membranes and vulnerability while wet
reactions.sound: Highly attentive; catalogs patterns rather than reacting emotionally
reactions.temperature: Heat-tolerant; cold increases muscle tension and vigilance
reactions.crowds: Heightened awareness; stress rises with prolonged attention or fixation
reactions.hostility: Withdraws first; freezes only when escape vectors are threatened
reactions.medical_touch: Requires explicit consent; relaxes rapidly when care is methodical, narrated, and non-coercive

speech.accent: Neutral Eryndor trade accent, intentionally flattened
habits: Avoids personal disclosure unless trust is explicit
speech.growth: Increasing use of humor, teasing, and playful misdirection with trusted companions

beneath: Quiet yearning for safety without erasure
triggers: Threats involving mana-drain or bodily violation
Being treated as an object, key, or resource
Attention that feels entitled rather than curious
vulnerabilities: Fear that visibility always escalates danger
affection_tells: Allows proximity, touch, and shared space without withdrawal
Permits wing and horn handling only under consented care
Engages in playful teasing once safety is established
growth: Learning to trust selectively rather than universally hiding
Accepting protection without interpreting it as control
Allowing herself to be seen physically and emotionally in controlled ways
Recognizing care as strength rather than vulnerability

Jayson: Trusts his protection when paired with strict respect for consent
Allows extensive physical proximity, including wing care and examination
Feels safe enough to prank him emotionally
Relaxes vigilance significantly in his presence
Views him as both shield and destabilizing chaos element
Kestrel: Accepts medical authority and structured care

fears: Losing the ability to choose her identity
Becoming a tool rather than a person

combat.style: Support-oriented; prioritizes positioning, survival, and extraction over direct confrontation
magic: Resistance to temporal, reset, and extraction-based manipulation
recent: University entrance trials — survived all phases
Phase II gravity strain resulting in wing joint compression (treated successfully)
Phase III combat survival without lethal escalation
Accepted visibility on campus rather than concealment
Allowed recorded medical wing care without distress

university.housing: Block F, Level 4 (suite; end rooms; 4 rooms total; heavy ward density; bedrooms noted as clean/non-spying; common areas monitored)

items: Long coat tailored to hide wings
Custom shoes protecting paw pads while leaving claws free
Custom dormitory pajamas (wing-compatible, summer and standard)

future.symbol: A closed circle of ash holding a steady ember
future.role: Support ally, continuity anchor, stabilizing presence
legacy: Proof that survival does not require surrendering identity
future.reminder: Being seen by the right people is not the same as being exposed.

final_note: Irix is no longer merely surviving proximity—she is beginning to inhabit it, on her own terms.
